question: Can complete coverage require a positive collective higher-order correction even when every individual triple has zero minimum over compatible covers?

representation.state_masses: x_S >= 0 for all 16 exact active sets S
representation.retained_inputs: total L, four singles D_i, and six pairs O_ij
representation.inclusive_triples: T_ijk = sum of x_S over S containing ijk
representation.identity: U + H = C := L - sum D_i + sum O_ij

frozen_candidate_rule: Minimize U using only retained moments. Continue only if the exact minimum is zero.
On the full-cover face U=0, minimize each inclusive triple T_ijk separately and minimize H.
The individual-triple selector fails if all four separate minima are zero.
The collective selector requests an upper bound on H only if min H is strictly positive.

If a supplied or derived upper bound h < min H is later available, reoptimize U under H <= h. This abstract round uses the explicit compatible open arrangement as a diagnostic bound H=0, not as a runner configuration.
Do not substitute sum T for H when Q may be positive.

prescribed_controls.name: symmetric_collective
prescribed_controls.purpose: Main paired countermodel: same retained moments admit full covers and an opening; each triple can separately vanish on the cover face.

prescribed_controls.name: zero_burden_partition
prescribed_controls.purpose: Negative control: full coverage by four singleton states, all individual and collective higher-order minima zero.

prescribed_controls.name: quadruple_correction
prescribed_controls.exact_state_distribution: x_1234=1/4 and each singleton x_i=3/16; all other masses zero
prescribed_controls.purpose: Countercheck that raw sum of triples overcounts the four-way state; H, not sum T alone, is the inclusion-exclusion correction.

falsification: Any exact pair-compatible full cover of the main moments with H < 1/7 falsifies the proposed collective lower bound.
A positive minimum for any individual main triple falsifies the claimed selector failure.
Failure to provide exact feasible primal countermodels and exact dual or pointwise certificates invalidates the calculation.
If the zero-burden control has positive H minimum, the rule is spuriously inventing higher-order burden.
If raw sum T equals C in the quadruple control, the correction accounting is wrong.

scope.models: Three prescribed abstract four-event controls only
scope.optimization_budget: At most 3 baseline LPs, 12 cover-constrained individual-triple LPs, 3 cover-constrained H LPs, and 1 H-upper repair LP; 16 logical states each
scope.verification: Exact rational primal/dual certificates plus a separately structured analytic/Mobius reconstruction
excluded: No physical runner realization claim or speed search

status: Finite abstract observations and elementary identity; implications for certificate design remain HYPOTHESIS/proof-candidate material. AI agreement is not independent mathematical validation.
